تختبئين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَبِئِينَ (taḵtabiʔīna) /tax.ta.bi.ʔiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
# تُخْتَبَئِينَ (tuḵtabaʔīna) /tux.ta.ba.ʔiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
